steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid setting.
Apply the required buyer bid-editing setting.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen permission setting.
Open the RFQ stage tab as required by the case.
Verify the RFQ tab remains visible after the interaction.
Verify that opening the RFQ tab produces no application error.
Confirm the resulting screen has no crash, server error, NaN, undefined, null, or raw IDs.
